messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — quick pre-QBR cost-health scrub for Acadia. Noticed a sudden spike in embedding credits over the last 7d, looks like a retention/regression risk if we don't act. Can we get finops + enablement eyes? :eyes:

dan_finops: Can you paste the numbers? rough daily / weekly change will help decide throttle vs. credit top-up.

maria_cs: sure, pasted short snapshot below — this is rolling 7-day vs prior 7-day

```
7d embeddings: +420% (1.2M -> 6.3M requests)
avg tokens/day: 85k -> 450k
est monthly spend delta: ~$14k -> ~$52k
top consumers: /api/v1/embed-bulk (60%), realtime-chat (25%), misc cron jobs (15%)
threshold alerts: none configured for embeddings_service
```

maria_cs: billing-bot flagged nothing (no high-cost alert), so this snuck past monitors. tagging @leo_onboard and @sam_success for enablement/ops context. :warning:

billing-bot: Automated alert: unusual increase in embedding units for customer Acadia detected. Please review usage and consider budget guardrails.

leo_onboard: Ack — thx for the flag. I'll take first pass on client-side causes (recent SDK update? new team usage?). Maria, do you have recent deploys or onboarding changes noted?

maria_cs: No platform deploys on their account. They did a product promo two weeks ago so could be real adoption. But the pattern shows many small rapid calls -> likely a misconfigured bulk job or loss of client-side batching.

sam_success: Recommend short playbook: 1) Finops estimate impact & propose temporary soft throttle, 2) Enablement reach out to customer with best-practice batching + caching, 3) Add budget alert + immediate credits-safety net if needed. Can we schedule a 30m sync today?

dan_finops: I can do the estimate now. If we apply a soft throttle at 10rps for embed-bulk we cut token spend ~70%. Proposal: enable a per-route budget cap and alert at 50% consumption. Also recommend adding a retroactive charge review if billing anomaly persists.

leo_onboard: I'll draft the enablement note with code examples for proper batching and KV cache usage. Example snippet to suggest:

```
# python pseudocode
chunks = chunkify(items, size=256)
for c in chunks:
    client.embed_batch(c)
# prefer 256-512 items/block and reuse model responses where possible
```

maria_cs: leaving a short action list here:
- dan_finops: confirm monthly delta and enable route cap (action: today)
- leo_onboard: outreach draft + batching snippet (action: today)
- sam_success: lead customer convo + confirm if promo caused spike (action: by EOD)
- billing-bot / platform: create embedding-service alert at 2x baseline (ops)

dan_finops: Confirmed — I'll push a temporary cap and set alert thresholds. Estimated savings if throttled: ~$9k/mo. If customer pushes back, we can offer a short-term credit while they fix batching.

sam_success: Scheduling 30m sync at 16:30 PT. Invite sent. We'll capture feedback in onboarding playbook and add a quick-run checklist to prevent recurrence. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll update the QBR prep doc with the cost delta and mitigation steps so it shows on the account health slide.

leo_onboard: FYI I'll include a one-pager on "embed efficiency" in the customer enablement pack.

billing-bot: Budget cap applied to route: embed-bulk (cap=10rps) — monitor for throttled errors and escalate if customer impacted.
